title: Princess Rosie and the Seven Birthday Stars

openingMoments.title: A celebration across the sea
openingMoments.copy: Far across the sparkling Sapphire Sea, Princess Zélie’s very first birthday celebration was almost ready. Gigi hung roses and ribbons from every golden arch.

openingMoments.title: Seven Stars flew away
openingMoments.copy: A playful wind scattered seven Birthday Stars across Fairytale Sicily. The Rainbow Paths to the Birthday Castle vanished!

openingMoments.title: Rosie and Stella can help
openingMoments.copy: Princess Rosie climbed onto Stella, her flying unicorn. “We’ll find every Star and bring everyone to the celebration!”

routes.name: Silver-ribbon canopy
